bookSourceComment:
LissAV 视频书源 v1.1 (261120)
站点: LissAV(asian日本区) + LissAV国产区(domestic)，x99dh 发布页线路池
架构: 单源；区(asian/domestic)与线路(23条域名池)由登录面板切换；{{LS_base()}} 动态拼 URL
播放: 详情页 videoUid → /{zone}/zh-CN/api/video/stream?video_uid= → playlist[0].url(m3u8)
     fetchm3u8 协议: 每个播放请求带 Accept: */*;sign={urlSign} 头（ruleContent URL选项注入）
面板: 发布页输入框+🧭一键取线路+⏱测速+12线路按钮翻页+🔍检查，全Toast
游客可看无登录。搜索无已知限频，未主动探测。兼容 LT(gedoor)+E(Luoyacheng) 双版
未验证: App 端 m3u8 播放（沙盒 CDN 不可达，需真机播放验证 sign 头方案）

ruleBookInfo.init: @js:(function(){var h=String(result);var o={};o.title=(h.match(/<title>[^|]*\| ([^<]*)<\/title>/)||['',''])[1];o.cover=(h.match(/property=\"og:image\" content=\"([^\"]+)\"/)||['',''])[1];o.desc=(h.match(/property=\"og:description\" content=\"([^\"]*)\"/)||['',''])[1];o.uid=(h.match(/var videoUid = \"([^\"]+)\"/)||['',''])[1];var ks=[];var rx=/<dt>类型<\/dt>[\s\S]*?<dd[^>]*>([\s\S]*?)<\/dd>/;var mm=h.match(rx);if(mm){mm[1].replace(/<a[^>]*>([^<]*)<\/a>/g,function(a,c){ks.push(c.trim());});}o.kind=ks.join(',');return JSON.stringify(o)})()

ruleContent.content: @js:(function(){var h=String(result);var uid=(h.match(/var videoUid = "([^"]+)"/)||["",""])[1];if(!uid)return '';var b=String(baseUrl);var zm=b.match(/\/(asian|domestic)\/zh-CN/);var zone=zm?zm[1]:'asian';var root=b.match(/^https?:\/\/[^/]+/)[0];var api=root+'/'+zone+'/zh-CN/api/video/stream?video_uid='+uid;var UA='Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/124.0.0.0 Safari/537.36';var s=String(java.ajax(api+',{"headers":{"User-Agent":"'+UA+'","Accept":"application/json"}}'));var urls=[],signs=[];try{var j=JSON.parse(s);var pl=j.playlist||[];for(var q=0;q<pl.length;q++){if(pl[q].url)urls.push(pl[q].url);signs.push(pl[q].urlSign||"");}}catch(e){}if(urls.length===0)return '';var best='',bestSG='';for(var i=0;i<urls.length;i++){  var sg=signs[i]||'';  var vopt=sg?',{"headers":{"User-Agent":"'+UA+'","Referer":"'+root+'/","Accept":"*/*;sign='+sg+'"}}':',{"headers":{"User-Agent":"'+UA+'"}}';  var probe='';for(var t=0;t<4;t++){try{probe=String(java.ajax(urls[i]+vopt)||'');}catch(e){}if(probe.indexOf('#EXTM3U')===0)break;}    if(probe.indexOf('#EXTM3U')===0&&probe.indexOf('tip.ts')<0){best=urls[i];bestSG=sg;break;}}if(!best)return '';if(bestSG)return best+',{"headers":{"User-Agent":"'+UA+'","Referer":"'+root+'/","Accept":"*/*;sign='+bestSG+'"}}';if(best.indexOf('.m3u8')<0)best=best+'?.m3u8';return best;})()
